About the Company

OnSpec DAQ Pty Ltd is an Australian company delivering intelligent and innovative engineering solutions to the Oil & Gas industry. The company specialises in wireline services, data acquisition systems, reservoir evaluation and engineering support, providing high-quality technical services through safe, efficient and innovative operational practices.

Our commitment is to deliver engineering excellence while maintaining the highest standards of safety, quality and environmental responsibility across all operations.

The Role

OnSpec is seeking an experienced Petroleum Engineer – Logging Technician (Wireline Services) to join our team in Chinchilla, Queensland.

This permanent full-time role combines petroleum engineering responsibilities with specialist wireline logging operations. The successful applicant will support reservoir evaluation, drilling, well completion, production optimisation and well intervention activities while providing technical leadership during wireline field operations.

The position requires a strong understanding of petroleum engineering principles together with practical experience in wireline logging services to support clients throughout exploration and production operations.

Key Responsibilities

Plan, design and optimise well intervention and reservoir evaluation programs to maximise hydrocarbon recovery.
Analyse geological, petrophysical and reservoir data to support drilling, completion and production decisions.
Develop engineering solutions to improve well productivity and operational efficiency.
Monitor well performance and recommend remedial actions based on engineering analysis.
Design and evaluate well completion and production strategies in accordance with engineering standards.
Provide technical support during drilling, completion and intervention operations.
Assess operational risks and ensure compliance with Health, Safety and Environmental (HSE) requirements.
Prepare engineering reports, technical recommendations and operational documentation.
Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams including geologists, drilling engineers and production engineers.
Review operational results and implement continuous improvement initiatives.
Operate wireline logging equipment to obtain accurate downhole formation and well integrity data.
Conduct open-hole and cased-hole logging operations in accordance with company procedures and client specifications.
Perform equipment testing, calibration and functional checks before field operations.
Interpret logging data to support reservoir evaluation and well diagnostics.
Troubleshoot wireline equipment and resolve technical issues during field activities.
Coordinate rig-up and rig-down activities ensuring safe operational execution.
Maintain engineering documentation, operational records and service reports.
Coordinate logistics, equipment utilisation and maintenance schedules.
Prepare post-job engineering reports and communicate technical outcomes to clients.
The Ideal Candidate

Bachelor’s Degree in Petroleum Engineering or a closely related engineering discipline.
Demonstrated experience in petroleum engineering, reservoir evaluation and wireline logging operations.
Sound understanding of drilling, completion, production and well intervention engineering.
Experience interpreting wireline logging data and supporting reservoir characterisation.
Strong analytical and engineering problem-solving skills.
Knowledge of Australian Health, Safety and Environmental (HSE) standards.
Current Australian C Class Driver Licence (essential).
Forklift Licence or willingness to obtain.
Excellent communication skills and the ability to work within multidisciplinary engineering teams.
No additional registration or licensing is required.

Diversity and Inclusion

OnSpec DAQ Pty Ltd is an equal opportunity employer. We encourage applications from Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples, women, the LGBTQIA+ community, mature-aged workers, people living with disabilities and applicants from culturally diverse backgrounds.

Mystery shopping is a great way to earn some extra income whist doing the things you already do and enjoy. You simply visit your chosen location as you would as a normal paying customer, once you have finished your visit you fill out an online questionnaire explaining how the visit went and what you observed whilst you were there. How much am I paid per job?

The payments per job vary based on how long the assignment may take and how much is involved, you will be emailed all the detail including the amount being offered for payment for each job and then you choose to accept the job if you wish. How many jobs do I have to do?

You can choose to do as many or as few as you like, you are not obligated to do a specific number so you get to choose the ones you really want. 

How many jobs can I expect?

There are no guarantees of any number of jobs as it all depends on the areas you have chosen to work and the clients we are working with at the time. After your report has been accepted by our QA team you will be paid within 14 days, straight into your nominated bank account.

You will be emailed about jobs that become available in your chosen areas.

An ABN number is a great idea to have if you are looking to do Mystery shopping on a regular basis, alternatively, if it suits your personal tax situation you can send us a completed ‘Statement By Supplier’ form that you can download from the ATO website.
